_comment: Live quality scorecard eval set for the curated demo KB (東洋精機). Ground-truth expected_evidence = the approved document that should back each query. Run with scripts/demo/quality_scorecard.sh to measure recall@k / groundedness / high-risk recall / security checks against the running demo. Used to baseline and track retrieval/answer quality (e.g. before/after Japanese-aware retrieval).
